As of September 30, 2026, the Company had unrestricted cash of approximately $54.5 million. The Company sold all of its BTC during the three months ended September 30, 2026 for net proceeds of approximately $80.1 million, a portion of which was used to repay its outstanding loan balance of $20.0 million, plus interest (see Note 4 – Digital Assets). The Company believes that its cash on hand and other working capital will be sufficient to meet its obligations as they become due over the next twelve months from the date these condensed consolidated financial statements were issued.
